Maya Singh: Quick preflight for launch content. Need decisions on three things: anchor text strategy, minimal JSON-LD for the webinar, and how we handle old campaign redirects. Fast replies please.
Evan Holt: Anchors: product pages get short, intent-focused anchors (e.g., "benchmarking LLM inference"). Blog hubs get descriptive anchors (e.g., "inference cost and latency benchmarks").
Priya Rao: Redirects: explicit 301s for known mappings. For unknown legacy URLs, route to a lightweight discovery page with suggested links (status 307/temporary) for 60 days, then 410 if no match. Keeps crawler signals clean.
Maya Singh: Good. Evan can you paste a tiny sample CSV for redirects?
Evan Holt: CSV snippet: ```
old_path,new_path,type
/lp/redwood-2024,/launch/benchmark-narrative,301
/campaigns/seed-2024,/resources/seed-guide,301
```
Priya Rao: JSON-LD for webinar (mini): ```{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood: Inference Benchmarks Webinar","startDate":"2026-06-02T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example/webinar/benchmarks"}}```
Maya Singh: Tracking note: strip UTMs on redirects but capture orig_campaign in a short param (?oc=) server-side for analytics stitching. Avoid long UTM chains.
Evan Holt: Also add rel=canonical on destination pages and canonical header on old pages during rollout to avoid split index signals.
geo-bot: Reminder: update sitemap and submit to Search Console after redirects verified on staging.
Maya Singh: Action items: Evan -> push redirects.csv to staging and QA 301s by EOD. Priya -> finalize JSON-LD + FAQ snippets. I'll review and merge. Ping this thread when PRs ready. :rocket:
